body.x: Gyeongbuk Province (Governor Lee Chul-woo)operated the Daegu-Gyeongbuk Joint Pavilion at CES 2020 held in Las Vegas fromJanuary 7 to 10, and proudly promoted the technology of the product on theworld stage.

Major Gyeongbuk companies participating inthe joint pavilion are RNS (display and bulletproof sheet), such as IDEL Co.,Ltd. (display and bulletproof sheet), Wooshin Industry (image equipment andsoftware), and Daeyoung Electronics (air cleaner, LED lighting, robot cleaner).
AVING News took the time to talk to JeonWoo-heon, Governor of Gyeongbuk Province, about the operation of the CES 2020Joint Pavilion. Let’s watch the video. Below is the full interview.

Q: Hello! We are now at CES 2020, theworld's largest technology exhibition. Where I am now is the center of Korea’sinnovation, Daegu Gyeongbuk Joint Pavilion. Let's talk with the GyeongbukEconomic Deputy Director Jeon Woo-heon. This time, you have formed a joint hallfor the win-win cooperation between Daegu and Gyeongbuk and you participated.Please tell us how you feel.

A: In Gyeongbuk Province, there are manySMEs and many venture companies. By making these companies participate in theseexhibitions, they can develop the eyes on the world market, and they can getthe chance to receive world approval. They will also receive a lot of help infinding sales channels.

I see the participation in CES a greatopportunity. I believe that this will be a great help in developing smallbusinesses and venture companies. So in Gyeongbuk Province, we will continuehelping the participation in these exhibitions.

Q: You participated for the first time thisyear, and I think the companies really like it. Companies seem to be expectinga lot from this. I would like to know what your plan for the future is in theexhibition.

A: Last year, from the recommendation fromMayor Kwon Young-jin, we ran a joint pavilion this year. This is our firstexhibition as Gyeongbuk Province. Even though the show ran for just one day,the CEOs of the companies are saying that it was really effective. So, weGyeongbuk province will participate in many of this exhibition. Not only this,but in MWC in February, and other international exhibitions as well.

So, in such exhibition, our companies canprove themselves. And by exactly understanding the changing trend, I think itwill be a good opportunity to establish various things to do in the future. Wewill encourage a lot of participation in the future.
